sentences.text: 8] Counsel for the State has submitted that appropriate order may be passed.

9] Having considered the rival submissions, perusal of the documents filed on record, and the fact that the compromise arrived at between the parties and that respondent no.2/complainant has no objection, this Court is inclined to allow the present petition.

10] Accordingly, the petition is hereby allowed and the FIR bearing Crime No.388/2022 for the offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(N), 323, 294, 506 of I.P.C., registered at Police Station Vijay Nagar, District Indore, and other consequential proceedings arising out of the said crime number, so far as it relates to the present petitioner is hereby quashed.
11] Accordingly, the petition stands allowed and disposed of.
